description: Finds rows in a contact or customer CSV that are probably the same person, using emails, phone numbers, names and companies. Use to clean a CRM export, mailing list or customer list. Read-only, and never uses the network. Results include names from the file, so they reach the model. Report review pairs to the user instead of deciding them.

columns.description: Column names by field (email, phone, name, first, last, company, city), when detection fails

limit.description: Most groups and review pairs to return, default 100. 0 returns only the counts

path.description: Path to the contact CSV file

name: contacts_find_duplicates
title: Find duplicate contacts
